name: hyperframes-cli
title_zh: 用命令行全流程驱动 HyperFrames 视频生成
tagline_zh: 从 init 到 publish 一条龙，40+ 子命令覆盖渲染、对比、云跑、字幕。适合把视频流水线当代码管的团队。
tagline_en: Drive HyperFrames end-to-end from the terminal: 40+ subcommands for render, compare, cloud, captions. For teams.
desc_en: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render fai
why_zh: 把视频制作拆成可 lint、可 snapshot、可 grade-compare 的工程步骤。
why_en: Turns video production into lintable, snapshot-able, grade-compare-able engineering steps—every change is reviewable, not a.
limit_zh: 只认 HyperFrames 自家项目结构，非其工程目录下 init 会失败；渲染依赖本机已装 ffmpeg 和相应模。
limit_en: Only works inside HyperFrames project structure; requires local ffmpeg + model weights or capture stalls; no source editing—generation and.
